title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Contract Provisions: Crediting of Interest
content:
Interest provisions of Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts — the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity and the Ashgrove SecureRate 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10.

## Provisions in force

1. **Minimum rate.** The rate a guarantee period earns is an annual effective rate never below the tier's guaranteed minimum interest rate.
2. **Flexible premium bonus.** On the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity, the first-year interest bonus is added for the first contract year only, and each later contract year earns the rate declared for it.
3. **Anniversary crediting.** Interest is credited on each contract anniversary for the contract year.
4. **Additional premiums.** Each additional premium earns interest from the day it is credited.
5. **Renewal.** A guarantee period renews under the guarantee period renewal provisions.

## Retired wording

The following wording of this provision is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis and is kept only as the record of the former text; it is not applied:

- "Each guarantee period earns the rate guaranteed for it."
- "The rate for a new guarantee period is the current base rate plus the high band rate addition when the premium (or, at renewal, the contract value on the renewal date) is at least the high band threshold."
- The words by which interest was also credited "on the date of any withdrawal, surrender, death benefit payment or annuitization for the part year since the last crediting".
- The words "at the daily equivalent of the annual effective rate for actual calendar days".

The tier figures named here (guaranteed minimum interest rate, current base rate, high band threshold, high band rate addition, first-year interest bonus) keep their values; only the retired wording above is withdrawn.

## Worked illustrations of the provisions in force (hypothetical figures)

- *Floor.* No rate a guarantee period earns is below 1.00%, the guaranteed minimum interest rate of every tier.
- *Bonus.* If the rate otherwise declared for the first contract year of an Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity were 3.25%, the first-year interest bonus of 1.00% makes the first contract year earn 4.25%; the second contract year earns the rate declared for it, with no bonus.
- *Additional premium.* A $1000 additional premium credited on 14 May earns interest from 14 May.
